import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression
from sklearn.metrics import r2_score

d = pd.read_csv("deliveries.csv")
ok = d[d["actual_min"].between(1, 299)].copy()
ok["walk"] = (ok["courier"] == "пеший").astype(int)
X = ok[["distance_km", "items", "walk"]].values
y = ok["actual_min"].values
Pd = np.array([[1, 0], [0, 1], [0, 0]])
rank_d = int(np.linalg.matrix_rank(Pd))
shape_d = (X @ Pd).shape
a = LinearRegression().fit(X,y)
b = LinearRegression().fit(X @ Pd,y)
r_full = r2_score(y,a.predict(X))
r_drop = r2_score(y,b.predict(X @ Pd))
r2_full = round(float(r_full),4)
r2_drop = round(float(r_drop),4)
lost = round(float(r_full-r_drop),4)

import pandas as pd
from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression

d = pd.read_csv("deliveries.csv")

ok["walk"] = (ok["courier"] == "пеший").astype(int)

b = LinearRegression().fit(X @ P,y)
w = a.coef_
w_p = b.coef_

match = bool(np.allclose(w_p,w_formula))
same_intercept = bool(np.isclose(a.intercept_,b.intercept_))
expect: Q1: Сверить веса смеси с алгеброй. Q2: Формула w_prime=P^-1@w и отсутствие сдвига. Q3: matchTrue,same_interceptTrue.

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
d = pd.read_csv("deliveries.csv")
ok = d[d["actual_min"].between(1, 299)].copy()
ok["walk"] = (ok["courier"] == "пеший").astype(int)
X = ok[["distance_km", "items", "walk"]].values.astype(float)
hidden = X @ np.random.default_rng(1).normal(size=(3, 3))   # P подрядчику неизвестна
known = X[:3]                                               # а эти три строки — известны
P_found = np.linalg.solve(known,hidden[:3])
restored = hidden @ np.linalg.inv(P_found)
max_err = float(np.abs(restored-X).max())
leaked = bool(max_err<1e-6)
expect: Q1: Проверить, вскрывает ли три известных строки остальные доставки. Q2: Предупреждение про известные пары и условие solve. Q3: При независимых known ключ и вся таблица восстановятся.

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression
from sklearn.tree import DecisionTreeRegressor
from sklearn.neighbors import KNeighborsRegressor
from sklearn.metrics import r2_score

d = pd.read_csv("deliveries.csv")
ok = d[d["actual_min"].between(1, 299)].copy()
ok["walk"] = (ok["courier"] == "пеший").astype(int)
X = ok[["distance_km", "items", "walk"]].values
y = ok["actual_min"].values
P = np.random.default_rng(1).normal(size=(3, 3))
rows = []
for cls in [LinearRegression,lambda: DecisionTreeRegressor(max_depth=4,random_state=0),lambda: KNeighborsRegressor(n_neighbors=15,n_jobs=1)]:
    a = cls().fit(X,y)
    b = cls().fit(X @ P,y)
    rows.append([r2_score(y,a.predict(X)),r2_score(y,b.predict(X @ P))])
raw = pd.DataFrame(rows,index=["linear","tree","knn"],columns=["x","xp"])
cmp = raw.round(3)
sensitive = raw.index[(raw.x-raw.xp).abs()>0.02].tolist()
expect: Q1: Сравнить чувствительность трёх алгоритмов к смеси. Q2: Таблица А дерево замечает с seed1. Q3: linear не чувствителен, tree и knn меняют R² более0.02.
